x-eas.doc: Kelly log-growth rate over edge by bet fraction: green where betting grows the bankroll, red where over-betting shrinks it.

data.doc: rows {edge, fraction, growth}: stats.kelly.growth over the grid (invest metric run --grid; docs/3d-valuation.md; financial-chart-3d-kelly-surface computes it)

model.doc: "binary" or "continuous" (stats.kelly.growth's model): the model the growth rows come from, for the record

sigma.doc: continuous model: annualised volatility of the asset; binary: unused

odds.doc: binary model: net odds b paid on a win; continuous: unused

description.default: Kelly log-growth rate over edge by bet fraction: green where betting grows the bankroll, red where over-betting shrinks it.
description.doc: the takeaway; alt text and table-view fallback (bin/chart check requires it)
